notes.title: Helle's Underwater City Project ver1.3.0 has been released.
Notification of ver1.2.0 update
notes.content:
We are pleased to inform you about the contents of the update implemented on November 30.

- Support for implementation of the Nagino Mashiro Resettlement DLC
As it will appear as DLC, it will no longer appear as a tourist.

Updates
Update and correction of the staff roll

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Free DLC is now available!
notes.content:
Vtuber『凪乃ましろ』とのコラボ企画を盛り上げてくださった御礼と感謝として、凪乃ましろの専用住居と住民化DLCを配信しました！

●Addition of a special residence with a "Mashiro Nagino" motif!
This DLC adds research for a special "Mashiro Nagino"-motif residence that can be built only once in the game.
Please acquire the building from the research and welcome "Mashiro Nagino" to your garden!

●Mashiro Nagino" is moving to the Garden! Mashiro Nagino" will appear as a new character from a tourist to a resident!

Mashiro Nagino," who appeared as a "tourist" in the first version, will appear as a resident character in this DLC.
As a resident character, you can have her appear anywhere and anytime you like!

notes.title: Notice of ver1.1.0 update
notes.content:
We are pleased to inform you of the update
We would like to inform you about the contents of the update.

New tourists have appeared in the undersea city where Hele lives!

Parameters of buildings have been adjusted.
- Balance adjustment of building cost and supply of Mira's Flowers.

- Balance adjustment of exchange costs at exchange offices for each resource will be implemented.

Replacement of some buttons and modal SEs

Replacement of certain character tips
- Correction of dot illustrations of some main characters

Update of staff rolls
- Credits will be added for collaboration measures.

- Credits will be added for all supporters who have been asked to support the game since its release date (October 6).

Bug Fixes
The following known bugs will be fixed or suppressed

- When pressing the move command at the maximum wave of search, the air consumption return text is displayed, but the search is successful.

- Freezing of torpedo firing under certain circumstances has been fixed.

- Suppression of the problem that all achievements are not canceled when the last achievement of 150 years is completed.
(Tip: In the unlikely event that all achievements are not removed, they can still be removed by restarting the game (this has been the case prior to this fix).

- Double-clicking in the building menu leaves a preview of the building.

- Corrected an error in the speaker of a line in some EPs.

notes.title: Notice of mini update
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Hele's Undersea City Project.

We have fixed and improved some bugs that we are currently checking.

Improvements

- Adjustment of the volume of the air-just-above-the-water sound during exploration.

Bug fixes.

- Mira's Flower not working properly in some language settings.
- Issue where level up could be done without the required materials.
- Issue where saved data prior to ver1.0.1 could not be released even if story release conditions were met.
- Problem with infinite number of tourists.
- Issue where the gold wool achievement (raising the float to level 3) cannot be unlocked.
This problem was caused in part by an issue that occurred in ver 1.0.3 that prevented the correct level-up.
We have corrected the data that could not be unlocked so that the level of the floats will return to 1.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but it is possible to unlock the achievements by setting the float level to 3 again.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you in advance for your patience.

notes.title: Notice of mini update
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Hele's Undersea City Project.


We have fixed and improved some bugs confirmed in ver1.0.1.

.
-The current location is now highlighted even during end-of-road construction.




The amount of air required for building and leveling up Mira's flowers has been reduced to 0. 




The following bugs have been fixed.

-The behavior of the game's clear status sometimes did not work properly in certain environments and situations.

Issue where, when starting a new game, buildings that had been released in the previous data may have already been researched.

-Problem with achievements being cancelled even though all oparts have not been collected.

-Problem with story EP3 not being viewable after starting in the middle of the story, even though the conditions are met.

Issue where the game screen cannot be zoomed in or out under certain circumstances.

-Problem with being able to build or relocate outside of an area.



-Corrected the position of ruby (furigana) in scenarios.

-Fixed a problem in which dialogue from another scene was inserted in some episodes. 



.
-Problem that in rare cases when firing torpedoes during search, the animation would stop and progress would become impossible.

We have confirmed that this occurs when repeatedly hitting the button while the animation is playing, and we are currently working on fixing the issue.
We have confirmed that this does not affect normal play, so we ask for your cooperation in refraining from hitting repeatedly during animations.




・Issue where the game may crash if the relocation is repeated repeatedly over a short period of time.

The game may be forced to terminate if relocation is continued repeatedly in a way that was not originally anticipated.
Although this is a bug that does not occur in normal game play,
We are working to confirm and correct this issue, so please be patient.



We will continue to fix the issue and update the game to make it even more enjoyable to play.

Thank you for your continued support of "Hele's Undersea City Project".

notes.title: Notice of mini update
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Hele's Undersea City Project.

We have fixed some bugs and made some improvements that we are currently confirming.


∙ An issue where the in-game BGM and SE were mono. 
Fixed to stereo sound source, which is the original specification.
This will allow users to enjoy sound effects and music with the original sense of presence.


∙ The cell detail panel for dwellings and the building information panel are now displayed. 
∙ The drop-down in the Architecture menu has been modified to be only for Lv1. 

We are planning to update the game in the future to make it even more enjoyable to play.

Thank you for your continued support of "Hele's Undersea City Project".
